modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ecotry: Bridge between EcoBal and command blocks: /ecotry take|give|has really fail when there is not enough money, so 'execute store success' and conditional chain command blocks can branch on it. /ecotry balance returns the balance as the command result.
ecotry.language.name: English
ecotry.command.not_enough: %1$s does not have enough money: %2$s needed, balance %3$s.
ecotry.command.not_enough.multi: None of the %1$s players has enough money (%2$s needed).
ecotry.command.balance.failure: Could not read the balance of %1$s.
config.ecotry.title: EcoTry Settings
config.ecotry.ui.remote: You are playing on a server: these settings only apply to your own worlds. The server uses its own config/ecotry.json.
config.ecotry.ui.map_hint: One entry per line: key = value
config.ecotry.ui.invalid: Some values are invalid (shown in red).
config.ecotry.ui.discard.title: Discard changes?
config.ecotry.ui.discard.message: Your changes to the settings have not been saved.
config.ecotry.playerFeedback.tooltip: Whether take/give/has send the affected player a short message. A trailing notify or silent on the command overrides this for that one call.
config.ecotry.actionBar.tooltip: Shows the player message in the action bar instead of the chat.
config.ecotry.language.tooltip: Language of all texts for players who don't have the mod installed. Players with the mod see their own game language. Messages you have not changed switch along.
config.ecotry.messages.takeSuccess.toolt: Sent after money was taken. Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecotry.messages.takeFailure.toolt: Sent when the player has too little money. Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecotry.messages.giveSuccess.toolt: Sent after money was paid out. Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecotry.messages.giveFailure.toolt: Sent when EcoBal could not pay out. Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecotry.messages.hasSuccess.toolti: Sent when the player has enough money (nothing is taken). Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
config.ecotry.messages.hasFailure.toolti: Sent when the player has too little money. Placeholders: {player}, {amount}, {balance} (after the command). & color codes and &#RRGGBB work; empty = no message.
